title_zh: Explorations and exchanges — 第41节可背诵讲义
body_en: Explorations and exchanges connect people across places. Students may visit another school or write to a pen friend. Prepare questions and listen more than you speak. Share food, songs, or school rules with care. Exchange means both sides learn.
body_zh: 探索与交流把不同地方的人连起来。学生可能访问另一所学校或给笔友写信。准备问题，多听少说。小心地分享食物、歌曲或校规。交流意味着双方都学习。
